steps.content: You head below deck. The power's out, and you can only rely on the weak beam of a flashlight to check your surroundings.
The boiler room is in shambles. Stacks of supplies, meant for longer trips into the DisSea, have been smashed to bits.

steps.speaker: Reid
steps.content: Hey little one, don't come in here. There's nowhere to stand. I'm just grabbing some spare weapons. You stay there.
As you stare at the black ichor sprawled across the floor, that voice pierces your mind once again like a needle.
It's you... I've been... waiting for you...
You are me... you are the Abyss... you are darkness...
